actions.description: Copy a Word document to a (possibly different) folder, optionally renaming it.
actions.name: copy-word-document

driveId.description: The ID of the drive containing the source document. Example: "b!PkCXTGMWc0aQ-tL4aQtFEDRX0SkZPfZDl2tD7OP_gahvi-nd5TAvTJG6KTmx6Mm0"

itemId.description: The ID of the Word document to copy. Example: "01RFYLAYGCHWM67HNJIZBJNCQTFNXT6YGT"

name.description: Optional new name for the copied document. If omitted and no destination is given, a unique name is generated automatically to avoid overwriting the source.

destinationDriveId.description: Optional ID of the destination drive. Defaults to the source drive if omitted. If provided without destinationFolderId, the drive root is used.

destinationFolderId.description: Optional ID of the destination folder. If omitted, the copy is placed in the same folder as the source (or the destination drive root).

location.description: Polling URL for async copy status when the copy is not completed synchronously.

actions.description: Create a folder in a drive to organize Word documents.
actions.name: create-folder

driveId.description: The ID of the drive where the folder will be created. Example: "b!PkCXTGMWc0aQ-tL4aQtFEDRX0SkZPfZDl2tD7OP_gahvi-nd5TAvTJG6KTmx6Mm0"

name.description: The name of the new folder. Example: "My Documents"

parentId.description: The ID of the parent folder. If omitted, the folder is created at the root of the drive. Example: "01RFYLAYGCHWM67HNJIZBJNCQTFNXT6YGT"

conflictBehavior.description: Behavior if a folder with the same name already exists. Defaults to "rename".

actions.description: Create a sharing link for a Word document.
actions.name: create-sharing-link

driveId.description: Drive ID containing the Word document. Example: "b!PkCXTGMWc0aQ-tL4aQtFEDRX0SkZPfZDl2tD7OP_gahvi-nd5TAvTJG6KTmx6Mm0"

itemId.description: DriveItem ID of the Word document. Example: "01RFYLAYGCHWM67HNJIZBJNCQTFNXT6YGT"

type.description: Permission type for the sharing link.

scope.description: Scope of the sharing link. Omit to use the tenant/site default scope.

actions.description: Upload a new Word document to a drive folder
actions.name: create-word-document

parentId.description: Parent folder item ID. If provided, the file is created in this folder instead of the root.

path.description: Folder path within the drive root. Used if parentId is not provided. Example: "folder/subfolder"

fileName.description: Name of the file including .docx extension. Example: "document.docx"

contentBase64.description: Base64-encoded .docx file content. Must not exceed 250 MB decoded.

itemId.description: DriveItem ID of the Word document. Example: "01RFYLAYGCHWM67HNJIZBJNCQTFNXT6YGT"

actions.description: Get the default document library (drive) for a SharePoint site.
actions.name: get-site-drive

actions.description: Download a Word document converted to PDF
actions.name: get-word-document-as-pdf

content.description: PDF content as a base64-encoded string

contentType.description: Content-Type header value from the response

size.description: Size of the PDF content in bytes

actions.description: Download the raw .docx content of a Word document.
actions.name: get-word-document-content

actions.description: Retrieve metadata for a Word document (driveItem).
actions.name: get-word-document

driveId.description: The ID of the drive containing the document. Example: "b!PkCXTGMWc0aQ-tL4aQtFEDRX0SkZPfZDl2tD7OP_gahvi-nd5TAvTJG6KTmx6Mm0"

itemId.description: The ID of the Word document (driveItem). Example: "01RFYLAYGCHWM67HNJIZBJNCQTFNXT6YGT"

actions.description: Search/list SharePoint sites accessible to the app
actions.name: list-sites

query.description: Search query. Use "*" for a broad listing of all accessible sites.

cursor.description: Pagination cursor from the previous response nextLink field.

nextLink.description: URL to retrieve the next page of results.

actions.description: List/search tenant users, to resolve a user id for personal OneDrive access.
actions.name: list-users

top.description: Maximum number of users to return per page. Example: 10

cursor.description: Pagination cursor from the previous response (@odata.nextLink). Omit for the first page.

actions.description: List sharing permissions on a Word document.
actions.name: list-word-document-permissions

actions.description: List the version history of a Word document.
actions.name: list-word-document-versions

driveId.description: The ID of the drive containing the document. Example: "b!PkCXTGMWc0aQ-tL4aQtFEDRX0SkZPfZDl2tD7OP_gahvi-nd5TAvTJG6KTmx6Mm0"

itemId.description: The ID of the Word document (driveItem). Example: "01RFYLAYGCHWM67HNJIZBJNCQTFNXT6YGT"

cursor.description: Pagination cursor from the previous response (the value of nextLink). Omit for the first page.

query.description: Search query to filter documents by name. Omit to list documents in the root folder only (not recursive).

cursor.description: Pagination cursor from the previous response. Omit for the first page.

actions.description: Move a Word document to a different folder.
actions.name: move-word-document

driveId.description: Drive ID containing the document. Example: "b!abc123"

itemId.description: ID of the Word document (driveItem) to move. Example: "01RFYLAY..."

destinationFolderId.description: ID of the destination folder (driveItem) within the same drive. Example: "01RFYLAY..."

actions.description: Replace the content of an existing Word document.
actions.name: update-word-document-content

driveId.description: The ID of the drive containing the document. Example: "b!PkCXTGMWc0aQ-tL4aQtFEDRX0SkZPfZDl2tD7OP_gahvi-nd5TAvTJG6KTmx6Mm0"

itemId.description: The ID of the Word document driveItem to update. Example: "01RFYLAYGCHWM67HNJIZBJNCQTFNXT6YGT"

content.description: Base64-encoded .docx file content to replace the existing document content. Must not exceed 250 MB decoded.

actions.description: Rename a Word document or update its description, without touching content.
actions.name: update-word-document-metadata

driveId.description: The ID of the drive containing the document. Example: "b!PkCXTGMWc0aQ-tL4aQtFEDRX0SkZPfZDl2tD7OP_gahvi-nd5TAvTJG6KTmx6Mm0"

itemId.description: The ID of the driveItem (Word document). Example: "01RFYLAYGCHWM67HNJIZBJNCQTFNXT6YGT"

name.description: The new name for the document. Example: "updated-name.docx"

description.description: The new description for the document. Pass null to clear.
